name: search_evidence
description: Discover passages by topic/text; read previews before citing. Use returned IDs/folders, never topics as folders. For recorded activity use include_history and activity_range; timestamps/backlog do not establish activity. The range filters text changes, not deadlines or real-world event dates: omit it to find events in unchanged/later-authored text. Continue with cursor only. For current deadlines try literal @due.

end.description: Exclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

start.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for local dates; defaults to the run's supplied timezone.

include_history.description: Include retained added/removed, even superseded lines. Requires activity_range; not current status. With query use literal/regex.

query.description: Match content; history matches changed text, not titles. Omit for all activity, then narrow by returned noteId.

name: list_note_activity
description: Discover distinct notes with one representative passage each for an activity_range. Apply search_evidence discovery rules: previews need reading, scopes must be known, ranges filter text changes rather than deadlines/events. For recorded activity include_history; timestamps/backlog and note counts do not establish work. Use search_evidence within discovered scope for more changes. Continue with cursor only.

end.description: Exclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

start.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for local dates; defaults to the run's supplied timezone.

include_history.description: Include retained added/removed, even superseded lines. Requires activity_range; not current status. With query use literal/regex.

query.description: Match content; history matches changed text, not titles. Omit for all activity, then narrow by returned noteId.

name: read_evidence
description: Read evidence IDs or a known canonical note; continue with cursor only. Cite returned [S#] references; the app builds links. activity_range assesses temporal support separately from meaning: qualify uncertainty; never attribute not_established passages or supporting context to that period. Resolve actor, event date, negation and status before answering. Coverage excludes cleared history and discarded Editing Window states, and cannot establish a complete real-world record.

end.description: Exclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

start.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for local dates; defaults to the run's supplied timezone.

include_provenance.description: Default false. Expand only for lineage; validation, timing and activitySupport are always included.

note_id.description: Known canonical note ID; bounded current pages, no pending proposals.

name: get_active_note
description: Get the adjacent note's ID, bounded body, selection and hash. If the supplied hint already identifies it, use that ID with read_evidence for answers or read_working_note for edits.

name: read_working_note
description: Read bounded working-copy pages for reviewed edits; lines are 1-based. pendingChanges means unapproved content, not answer evidence. For recall use read_evidence.

name: propose_note_edits
description: Stage edits to a surfaced note; pendingChanges are folded into the combined preview. The user must Keep before disk changes. Submit through this tool. Deadlines: @due(YYYY-MM-DD), Gregorian years 0001-9999, on the exact checkbox line. Preserve unrelated/child text; when changing/removing a deadline consolidate only supported valid annotations on that line. No stored slash commands, due times or reminders.

contextAfter.description: Exact following anchor for insert/replace; omit for append/prepend.

contextBefore.description: Exact preceding anchor for insert/replace; omit for append/prepend.

kind.description: append/prepend: document boundaries. replace: exact oldText. insert: exact, unique contextBefore/contextAfter anchors.

oldText.description: Exact nonempty text for replace; otherwise omit.

name: propose_note_rewrite
description: Stage a whole-note cleanup, restructure, translation or tone change; use propose_note_edits for local changes. First read every working-copy page in this run, including pendingChanges. The user must Keep before disk changes. Submit through this tool. Deadlines: @due(YYYY-MM-DD), Gregorian years 0001-9999, on the exact checkbox line. Preserve unrelated/child text; when changing/removing a deadline consolidate only supported valid annotations on that line. No stored slash commands, due times or reminders.

markdown.description: Complete replacement body including all retained content; no managed frontmatter.

name: propose_create_note
description: Stage a new Markdown note. The user must Keep before a uniquely named file is created.

name: research_notes
description: Gather a focused remaining gap with a bounded worker sharing this run's provider/model, scope and budgets. Prefer direct reads for known passages; preserve allowance for other work. Returned passages are validated, already-read evidence: cite directly; on partial delivery read only remainingEvidenceIds. Follow direct-evidence recovery on failure. One worker at a time; repeat only for a different gap/scope. Returns selected passages, not its transcript. Cannot write, use web or delegate.

end.description: Exclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

start.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for local dates; defaults to the run's supplied timezone.

folder.description: Known vault-relative path only; never infer from topics.

note_ids.description: Known note IDs only; omit for discovery.

name: update_plan
description: Publish or update a concise user-visible plan for multi-step work. Do not include hidden reasoning. Re-send the full plan whenever a step changes.
